title: Scottsdale Stunner - Luxe Stay Near Old Town
description: Indulge in the ultimate Scottsdale experience at this exquisite 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom desert retreat, just minutes from vibrant Old Town Scottsdale. Spanning 3,400 square feet, this refined home showcases an open-concept layout, soaring ceilings, and curated designer interiors that blend modern elegance with effortless comfort.
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability
Beautiful property. Great location. Comfortable for large groups. Full kitchen with expansive island. 10/10 stay!

Had a great stay here. Beautiful home with plenty of space and it was very tidy. I’d recommend it for a big group event or weekend. Easy walk to coach house and grounds coffee. Nice views of a mountain from the second floor porch. One small issue was the security system to the pool, it was easy to trip the alarm but I believe it’s a city code requirement anyway. Really great location.

Had a great time staying at this property, which was very clean and had a great set up. Hosts were always very responsive and had clean instructions from check in to check out. Would definitely stay here again!

Great place to stay all in all. Great communication by the host and easy check in and out process. Only problem we had was the dryer being broken so we had to dry our clothes outside. Highly recommend
Very responsive and accommodating host. Would return!
